Smoky Black Bean Hand Pies Recipe

A made-up description of golden hand pies stuffed with beans and cheese.

Prep: 1 hour 10 minutes Cook: 25 minutes Total: 1 hour 35 minutes

Ingredients

  • 2⁄3 cup warm water (around 100°F)
  • 1 packet instant yeast
  • 2 1⁄2 cups all-purpose flour
  • 1 tsp salt
  • 3 Tbsp olive oil, divided
  • 1 can (15 oz) black beans, rinsed and drained
  • 1⁄2 cup frozen corn
  • 1 tsp smoked paprika
  • 1 cup shredded pepper jack cheese
  • 1⁄4 cup chopped cilantro
  • 1 egg, beaten
  • Salsa, for serving

Directions

  1. Stir the warm water and yeast together and let it sit until foamy.
  2. Mix in the flour, salt and 2 Tbsp oil, then knead into a soft dough.
  3. Cover the dough and let it rise for about an hour.
  4. Mash half the beans with the corn, paprika and remaining oil; fold in the rest.
  5. Cut the dough into 6 pieces, fill each with beans and cheese, and fold over.
  6. Brush with egg and bake at 425°F until golden, about 25 minutes.
